test_title: PYST 4: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: Select the option with the correct use of article(s).

options.text: I was rude to him when I was in the fit of rage.
I was rude to him when I was in fit of rage.
I was rude to him when I was in an fit of rage.
I was rude to him when I was in a fit of rage.

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. this part of the sentence is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** fourth sentence** correctly uses the indefinite article 'a' before the singular noun phrase 'fit of rage.'
 
• In English grammar, the indefinite article 'a' is used before words that begin with a consonant sound.
 
• The other options use articles incorrectly or omit them where necessary:
 
 
• **Option 1** incorrectly uses 'the' instead of 'a'.
 
• **Option 2 **omits the article entirely, which is incorrect.
 
• **Option 3** incorrectly uses 'an' instead of 'a' as 'fit' begins with a consonant sound.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.
